title: Pip Helps a Frog
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 longer-word practice, 60-sound stage (gl, gr, pl just added) — blending words like 'grips' and 'grins'.

pages.text: Pip sees a frog at the tub.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow spotting a small green frog beside a wooden water tub.

pages.text: The frog can not get up.
pages.illustration: The small green frog struggling against the smooth side of the wooden tub, unable to climb up.
Pip the sparrow flying down toward the tub.
Pip the sparrow picking up a thin twig in his beak.
The small green frog gripping the thin twig with its front legs.
Pip the sparrow helping pull the twig, lifting the frog up and out of the tub.
The small green frog grinning widely at Pip.
The small green frog hopping away across the grass.
Pip the sparrow watching the frog hop away, looking pleased.
